marc:datafield.marc:subfield: E-pirates of the digital age copyright issues in software & music

"New technology has had a staggering impact on the way people use information, and the speed at which it is introduced and utilised is just as quick. Some new technologies are so quickly integrated into the online world that they are not yet covered by government policy and laws, and this can lead to conflict between users and creators. This program examines the complex world of digital piracy and the copyright of computer-related media, including software, games and music" -- container.
